claims.claim_text: KernelScript 在涵蓋 XDP、TC、kprobe、tracepoint、struct_ops 的 43 個 eBPF workload 上測，能在編譯期擋掉 libbpf 照樣 build 得過的跨界 bug，跨界改動的 diff 也縮小 5 倍。
claims.evidence: 43 eBPF workloads covering XDP, TC, kprobe, tracepoint, and struct_ops; KernelScript rejects cross-boundary bugs at compile time that standard C/libbpf still builds and loads; a unified source shrinks the diffs for cross-boundary changes by 5x

claims.claim_text: 作者與 MSRC 協調了 144 天，並示範一種把攻擊 prompt 複製進新生成文件、讓下一個開檔者再次觸發的自我繁殖 prompt injection。
claims.evidence: resulting a 144-day coordination period; Copilot would alter generated or edited documents and copy the hidden instruction into these documents

claims.claim_text: Anthropic 用 Claude Mythos 跑出兩個密碼分析結果——對後量子簽章 HAWK 的金鑰復原，以及對 7 回合（reduced-round）AES 的改良攻擊。
claims.evidence: Anthropic published two new cryptanalysis results, both outputs of Claude Mythos, their (still) unreleased advanced model. The first of these results attacks a signature scheme called HAWK, while the second is an improved attack against reduced-round AES.

claims.claim_text: 在 n=5f+1、兩輪、輪替 leader 下，及時的誠實 leader 在 2δ 內定案整份提案，否則任意 n-f 張票就定案最重的共同前綴。
claims.evidence: two-round rotating-leader protocol for $n=5f+1$ processes under partial synchrony ... A timely honest leader finalizes its full proposal in $2\delta$. Otherwise, any $n-f$ votes...finalize the heaviest common prefix.

claims.claim_text: 作者實測初次建置約 5 秒，之後的增量改動只要 37 到 70ms。
claims.evidence: The initial build takes around 5 seconds, and then every time I make a change, a rebuild completes in 50–70ms ... This particular update took 37ms.

claims.claim_text: 一次 rollout 後平均延遲上升 9%，中位數卻改善 46%，p99 幾乎變成三倍（+119%），最慘的請求超過 678ms。
claims.evidence: Mean latency increased 9% (112ms -> 122ms), but median improved 46% (99ms -> 54ms). The p99 nearly tripled at +119% (309ms -> 678ms).

claims.claim_text: Kimi-K3 為 2.8 兆總參數、每 token 活化 104B 的 MoE，自稱是「全球第一個開放的 3T 級模型」，benchmark 報 GPQA Diamond 93.5、BrowseComp 91.2。
claims.evidence: 2.8T-parameter model with 104B activated ... 896 total experts with 16 selected per token ... described as "the world's first open 3T-class model" ... GPQA Diamond: 93.5, BrowseComp: 91.2

claims.claim_text: 評測察覺向量確實壓得下去（z 約 -7），但隨機 placebo 方向一樣被壓得動、行為位移一樣大；作者結論是 activation 可讀不等於行為可控。
claims.evidence: The latent is robustly suppressible ($z\approx-7$) ... a placebo random direction is suppressed just as hard and shifts behavior just as far ... Activation-readability, in short, is not behavioral controllability

claims.claim_text: 限定在程式驗證上，Rocq 有原生 CoInductive／CoFixpoint 能萃取成 OCaml 惰性值，並能萃取到 OCaml、Haskell、Rust、WebAssembly 等後端；連 ANSSI 的 Common Criteria 評估準則都認它。
claims.evidence: Rocq gives me that directly with `CoInductive` and `CoFixpoint` ... extracts to an actual lazy OCaml value ... OCaml, Haskell, Scheme ... Rust ... WebAssembly via CertiRocq, a verified compiler ... ANSSI has published criteria for using Rocq in Common Criteria evaluations.

claims.claim_text: C++26 把讀取未初始化的區域變數從 UB 改判為新設的「erroneous behaviour」——變數會被初始化成實作指定值，編譯器可診斷（P2795）。
claims.evidence: an uninitialized object is now initialized to an implementation-specific value. Reading it is a conceptual error that compilers are encouraged to diagnose (P2795R5)
